item.tib: dpal ldan kun grags mthong grol gling gi dgu gtor chen po'i phyag len shes ldan blo'i pad+mo 'byed pa'i sbrang char
item.coloph: ces dpal ldan kun grags mthong grol gling gi dgu gtor chen po'i lag len shes ldan blo yi bad+mo 'byed pa'i sbrang char zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rab 'byams zhing khams 'dul mdzad mchog gi rnam sprul mi yi zol brten pa gang gis kyang 'gran gyi zla dang bral ba/ lnga snyigs bstan 'gro'i skyabs rje me ston nyi ri wer zhi'i thugs dam phyag len ci bzhin/ rgyal theb smon lam g.yung drung bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rin po che mchog gis zhal bkod rtsal ltar te/ yi ge pa ni gang de'i bka' 'bangs gus phran mang+ga ming gis bgyis pas/ dge des sangs rgyas g.yungadrung bon gyibastan pa rin po che mkha' la nyi zla'i bsgrod pa ma chad kyi bar du phyogs bcu kun du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i rgyu gyur cig/
